title: Using LLM Agents to Evaluate Prosocial Interventions on Social Media Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2611.12922v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Social media platforms are a primary source of information for many users. Although research explores various interventions to promote prosocial content or demote harmful content on platforms, there are few systematic methods for evaluating competing intervention designs before conducting costly human-subject experiments. We develop a simulation-based evaluation pipeline built on the OASIS framework. We generate 13,835 LLM-based agents, each with a unique profile. Over 20 time steps, we expose them to real-world Twitter/X posts and let them comment, like, repost, or follow. We use those agents to systematically evaluate three interventions that increase exposure to verified news: adding content, upranking content, and celebrity source cues. All interventions significantly increase news engagement, with upranking news to prominent feed positions producing the largest effects. These effects hold across agents' gender, age, and education

translated_title: 使用大语言模型智能体评估社交媒体平台上的亲社会干预措施
translated_abstract: 社交媒体平台是许多用户获取信息的主要来源。尽管已有研究探索了各种干预措施来推广平台上的亲社会内容或降低有害内容的传播，但在开展成本高昂的人类受试者实验之前，很少有系统性的方法来评估相互竞争的干预设计方案。我们开发了一个基于OASIS框架构建的仿真评估流水线。我们生成了13,835个基于大语言模型的智能体，每个智能体都拥有独特的用户画像。在20个时间步内，我们将真实的Twitter/X帖子呈现给这些智能体，并让它们进行评论、点赞、转发或关注等操作。我们利用这些智能体系统地评估了三种提高经核实新闻曝光度的干预措施：添加内容、提升内容排名以及名人来源提示。所有干预措施都显著提高了新闻参与度，其中将新闻提升至信息流的显著位置产生了最大的效果。这些效果在不同性别、年龄和教育水平的智能体中均保持一致。
tldr: 该研究基于OASIS框架构建了一个包含13,835个大语言模型智能体的仿真评估流水线，系统评估了三种提升经核实新闻曝光度的干预措施，发现将新闻提升至信息流显著位置的效果最佳，为在开展昂贵的人类实验前筛选干预方案提供了系统方法。
en_tdlr: This study develops an OASIS-based simulation pipeline with 13,835 LLM agents to systematically evaluate three interventions for increasing verified news exposure on social media, finding that upranking news to prominent feed positions yields the largest effects, offering a systematic method for screening interventions before costly human-subject experiments.
